records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ana,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Timber Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Ana,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Timber Analytics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: First project reached 7/3 shows real activity, but no invites sent, no replies to two outreach emails (email:ee64131c, email:e41d1036), no tickets, and only 8 days left on a Starter plan. Partial momentum with zero two-way engagement suggests modest unaided odds.

draft.subject: One next step in your Wrenfield workspace
draft.body:
Hi Ana,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the fastest way to see how Wrenfield fits your workflow.

When you're ready to bring the rest of Timber Analytics in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through your setup with you and answer anything.

Best,
Priya
